question: REPLICATION of relay-screen-hard18-v1 (RELAY 4 vs REPLACE 0 rescues of 14) on a separate generic cohort: the 29 clean abstentions of the unhinted escalation arm esc_none of swarm-hints-hard16-v1 (6 puzzles), relay outcomes unseen. Owner rule: generic swarm only. Astra-designed fair test of task-agnostic closers (artifact relay): on the clean abstentions of the two generic hard-v18 arms (roll12cancel, roll12idle; each task-seed pair once), does handing up to 4 uniformly sampled failed-agent artifacts (last 12,000 characters, fixed generic protocol sentence: use what is correct, finish the task, answer in the required format) to new workers rescue more cases than the same number of fresh independent workers with the same budget?
design: Dev screen on recorded abstentions (outcomes of relay/replace unseen); the roll12strategy arm is excluded because its agents carried task-specific hints; repeated puzzles make the McNemar p descriptive only. RELAY arm then REPLACE arm, each alone on the fleet, each wrapped by inkling/account_cmd.py; paired by case; unchanged judge; cancel on accept within an arm; verifier only scores.
decision_rule: The hard-v18 screen replicates if RELAY rescues at least 3 more cases than REPLACE with 0 wrong in RELAY (McNemar descriptive: 6 puzzles). The in-swarm relay study proceeds only if, pooled over both screens, RELAY rescues more cases than REPLACE with 0 wrong.
